newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling amid dull sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling amid dull sentiment.

text.p: Bangladesh shares, which fell more than five percent on Sunday, may fall further on Monday with investors expected to keep to the sidelines, brokers said.
"The share prices may continue to fall as investors face cash liquidity problem after commercial banks tightened credit in a depressed market," said broker Mahbub Morshed.
Brokers said institutional investors were also unlikely to make commitments. They said share prices might fall across the board.
The DSE benchmark index closed 55 points, or 5.42 percent, lower at 959.7 on turnover of 38.6 million taka on Sunday.
